prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman in a fictional fashion gala portrait, with dark voluminous waves framing her face, defined eyes, soft lip color, luminous natural skin texture, gentle confident smile, and both hands raised in a graceful wave. She wears a black corset-inspired gown with delicate straps, central bow detail, lined midsection panels, and a multi-layered ruffled lace skirt with a dramatic flowing silhouette, plus a chunky diamond necklace and matching bracelet. Center her against a charcoal formal fictional media wall with abstract gold signatures and cleared sponsor-style marks, no real company logos. Use bright diffused event lighting at approximately 5000K with gentle fill, natural highlights on lace, diamonds, hair, and skin, an 85mm lens, vertical full-length composition, realistic pores, restrained highlights, and subtle event grain. Use an approved adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
